chunks: Ibn 'Isam, from al-Kulayni, from al-'Ulani, from al-Yaqtini, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Askari (peace be upon them) about the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And the earth entirely [will be] His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the heavens will be folded in His right hand.'
He said: That is a rebuke of Allah, Blessed and Elevated, for the one who likens Him to His creation. Do you not see that He said: 'And they have not estimated Allah with true estimation'?

And its meaning is when they said: 'The entire earth is His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the heavens are folded in His right hand,' just as He, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'And they have not estimated Allah with true estimation' when they said: 'Allah has not sent down anything to a human being.'
Then He, Mighty and Majestic, declared Himself free of 'grip' and 'right hand' by saying: 'Glorified is He and Elevated above what they associate [with Him].'

key_terms.بِيَمِينِهِ: In His right hand (attribute used in Quran)

ai.seo_question: How does the Imam explain the anthropomorphic attributes of Allah in the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn Muhammad (AS) elucidates that the Quranic descriptions of Allah's 'grip' and 'right hand' serve as a rebuke (ta'yeer) to those who anthropomorphize the Divine, contrasting with the claim that 'Allah has not sent down anything to a human.' This interpretation aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of distinguishing between divine attributes and created forms, emphasizing that terms like 'yamin' are used in their literal sense but not implying a physical limb. The Imam concludes by citing Allah's self-negation of these anthropomorphic associations, reinforcing the concept of tanzih (divine transcendence).

en.ammaar-muslim: 10. [10/337] al-Tawhid and Ma’ani al-Akhbar: Ibn Assam from al-Kulayni from al-Allan from al-Yaqtini who said:

I asked Aba al-Hasan Ali b. Muhammad al-Askari عليهما السلام about the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: “the entire earth will be His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the Heavens will be folded in His right hand” [39:67].

He said: That is a rebuke of Allah Blessed and Elevated against the one who likens Him to his creation. Don’t you see that He said (in the same verse): “they have not estimated Allah His true estimate” [39:67].

The meaning of this is (a reply to) when they said: ‘the entire earth will be His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the heavens will be folded in His right hand’. This is just as He Mighty and Majestic said: “they have not estimated Allah His true estimate” [6:91] when they said: “Allah has not sent down anything to a human” [6:91].

Then He Mighty and Majestic declared Himself free of (possessing attributes such as) ‘gripping’ and ‘right hand’ by saying: “Glorified is He and Elevated above what they associate (with Him)” [39:67].
